scope: CPU/network primary-source review only; no install/build/GPU/model or settings changes. Existing external-ideas-strata.txt/external-ideas-b70.txt and15idea ledger read first. Two distinct untested ideas retained, not a main-path blocker.

ideas.external_fact: Both document temporary prefill/cache capacity sharing. Strata lends expert-cache slots; MachX describes an elastic block reused between prefill scratch and decode expert cache.
ideas.new_local_inference: Use explicit phase-exclusive arenas to avoid permanently adding prefill workspace to the tight two-target128K footprint. Candidate alternatives: lend exact packed expert blocks with byte-identical refill before decode, or borrow provably unread/unwritten future KV tail and restore zero bytes before use. Future-KV borrowing is OUR inference, not claimed external implementation.
ideas.why_new: Different from permanent expert tiering/remoteKV, quantization or larger chunks alone: change lifetime overlap of exact storage, not values or arithmetic. May make wider chunks fit with current114.9MB final-target margin; no fit/speed claim.
ideas.cheapest_falsifying_test: CPU allocation-lifetime audit first: enumerate exact workspace bytes and borrowers, prove every native read/write including vector overreads stays outside borrowed ranges. Reject if no large exclusive extent or refill traffic dominates. Then one tiny real arena-borrow/refill operator test, all bytes restored and exact sealedstate through prompt->decode/context growth; only afterward changed-chunk gate.
ideas.constraints: Full16bit KV/FP32 recurrent state and original packed weights retained. Never overwrite live KV, checkpoint banks, or expert bytes still in use; fullACK/parity leases and arena accounting unchanged. No cache drops/settings changes.

ideas.external_fact: Strata documents file-order batched expert reads overlapped with copies as a separate load-time improvement.
ideas.new_local_inference: Pipeline reads/repacking/copies using a small fixed host-buffer budget and actual file order; preserve perowner device admission and final packed bytes. Prefer internal bounded transfer pipeline before concurrent full owner loads, which can raise transient RAM.
ideas.why_new: Startup wall time is distinct from existing kernel/expert-tiering/prompt pipeline ideas. Current first-inference request metrics exclude load, so any gain belongs to service readiness/end-user load-to-first-token, not559.908s request throughput.
ideas.cheapest_falsifying_test: First inspect retained readiness/load traces and existing loader to establish disk/read/copy/compile critical path. If I/O/copy is material, bound buffer memory and screen one actual tensor bank bytehash/transfer ordering; no whole-model parallel-loader rewrite before that. Reject if compile/kernel warmup dominates.
ideas.constraints: No readahead/pagecache/sysctl changes, cache flushing, model arithmetic or artifact changes. Fresh exclusive output, one controlled load and same final byte inventory; sourcegate if repacking changes.
